request: Dimmi il giorno della settimana di oggi
code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GIORNOSETT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-DATA PIC 9(8).
       01 WS-NUMERO BINARY-LONG.
       01 WS-GIORNO BINARY-LONG.
       01 WS-NOME PIC X(10).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           ACCEPT WS-DATA FROM DATE YYYYMMDD.
           COMPUTE WS-NUMERO =
               FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(WS-DATA).
           COMPUTE WS-GIORNO =
               FUNCTION MOD(WS-NUMERO - 1, 7) + 1.
           EVALUATE WS-GIORNO
               WHEN 1 MOVE "LUNEDI" TO WS-NOME
               WHEN 2 MOVE "MARTEDI" TO WS-NOME
               WHEN 3 MOVE "MERCOLEDI" TO WS-NOME
               WHEN 4 MOVE "GIOVEDI" TO WS-NOME
               WHEN 5 MOVE "VENERDI" TO WS-NOME
               WHEN 6 MOVE "SABATO" TO WS-NOME
               WHEN 7 MOVE "DOMENICA" TO WS-NOME
           END-EVALUATE.
           DISPLAY "OGGI E' " WS-NOME.
           STOP RUN.
